associations.rationale: The declaration asserts existence of a simple quaternionic-type representation, but its displayed type does not state that this representation is the unique two-dimensional irreducible.

The theorem states the real-type assertion for representations on the one-dimensional complex space, but it does not itself state uniqueness or quaternionic type of the two-dimensional irreducible, so it covers only one part of the source claim.

The theorem gives the uniqueness component for simple two-dimensional representations, but it does not itself state that the distinguished representation is quaternionic type or that the one-dimensional irreducibles are real type.
